honesty_rules: Show only what the record holds; a value the record does not hold renders as absent, never synthesized.
Defined-but-not-run experiments render as exactly that.
Weights and scores are read from the code and records at collection time, never transcribed from prose claims.
Workflow run counts are API observations stamped with their read time, not live claims.

data.what_it_scores: Pull requests. score(pr) in ml/pipelines/moneyball/scorer.py sums transparent signal weights and clamps the total.
data.stale_rule: staleness adds age_days * stale_day, floored at stale_cap

signals.condition: gates repo-gate == success AND termux-smoke == success
base ref set and not master (penalty)
per full day of age (penalty, floored at stale_cap)

data.explain_note: explain(pr) returns the score, the lane classification (ml.pipelines.lanes.classify), the full weights table, and the PR's recorded why.
consumers: ml/pipelines/command_center/board.py — scores shaped PRs onto the command-center board
data.quota_multiplier: ml/pipelines/moneyball/quota_weights.py: quota_multiplier(provider) scales a candidate's 3L0/ELO x role score by remaining-budget fraction over remaining-time fraction, capped at 2.0; 0 when a quota is exhausted; 1.0 (neutral) when there is no evidence or no readings file.

hex_contract.role: Hex is the analytics/evidence layer (docs/ops/HEX-MONEYBALL-INTEGRATION.md); GitHub Actions remains the execution plane and the durable ledger stays outside Hex.
hex_contract.identity: records key on the Actions run attempt (run_id + run_attempt), not the run alone

evidence_workflow.does: runs scripts/hex_moneyball_export.py — sanitizes an NDJSON agent telemetry stream into CSV records with a provenance manifest (scripts/hex_moneyball_artifact_provenance.py)

data.test_evidence: ml/pipelines/test_scorer.py: a clean candidate PR outscores a wholesale PR under the shipped weights; weights and clamp are unit-tested (test_weights.py, test_explain.py).

gaps: No committed per-PR MoneyBall score outputs exist in the repo: scores are computed live by the board/CLI at runtime and the evidence workflow's exports land as Actions artifacts, not committed files. This page therefore shows the scoring system exactly as coded, not a fabricated scoreboard.
